cards.prompt: Arithmetic mean vs geometric mean return

content.answer: Arithmetic is the simple average; geometric is the compound average. Geometric $\le$ arithmetic, and is used for multi-period performance.
acceptableAnswers: Arithmetic is the simple average; geometric is the compound average. Geometric ≤ arithmetic, and is used for multi-period performance.
